claim: The running substrate listens and looks all the time and keeps only what is said to it: an utterance with its taught name in it, and what follows within attention, is heard, remembered in words, looked at and answered through the front door; everything else is dropped inside the ear and never reaches it.
hypothesis: An utterance is kept exactly when the taught name is found in it or it follows a kept one within ATTENTION_SECONDS; a name taught while listening is listened for within the ear's re-teach interval; nothing dropped leaves a percept or a memory; the recording is never kept.
